criteria_location: Facet section is pp.13-18 of 34. procedures_covered: Diagnostic medial branch block (local anesthetic only)
Therapeutic intra-articular facet injection (only under exceptions)

logic.top_level: pathways: patient requirements (all of 6) AND a procedure-specific block; therapeutic IA injection has 4 alternative exception pathways, one of which (nerve root compression by cyst) has its own all-of
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Separate 'Exclusions' list (22 bullets, pp.16-17) introduced with 'Indications other than those addressed in this guideline are considered not medically necessary including, but not limited to the following'. Inline negatives in Patient Requirements ('Absence of prior surgical fusion at the proposed level').
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Explicit and the most detailed of the four documents. Dual MBB: 'injections performed in the same location(s) on two separate occasions at least one week apart'; max 4 diagnostic sessions per region per rolling 12 months; max 2 diagnostic sessions per level per year for RFA candidacy. Therapeutic IA (exceptions only): repeat if prior gave 'at least 50% reduction in pain with functional improvement of at least 3 months', max 4 sessions per region per rolling 12 months. RFN: 'no more than twice annually', repeat without new MBB if >=50% relief for >=6 months.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: an exception for therapeutic intraarticular facet injections may be considered medically necessary when ALL Patient Requirements for facet injections are met AND ANY of the following conditions (1-4) are documented
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Condition 4 carries its own 'ALL of the following' sub-criteria and a different clinical picture (radicular pain) that conflicts with the Patient Requirement of axial pain not due to radiculopathy (excepted only for cysts).

and_or_ambiguity.quote: For the exceptions listed above only: Therapeutic facet joint injection at the same anatomic site for recurrent pain may be repeated if...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The three bullets of repeat rules sit between items 3 and 4 of the numbered list, so it is unclear whether they apply to 1-3 only or 1-4.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Conservative management should include a combination of strategies ... including physical therapy AND at least one complementary conservative treatment strategy.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'should include' vs 'requires'; PT has three ANY-alternatives, one an exception for intractable pain.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Moderate-to-severe pain with functional impairment of at least 3 months' duration
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Duration attaches to pain, impairment or both; elsewhere conservative care only needs 6 weeks.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: A maximum of only 2 diagnostic sessions per level given on separate occasions are appropriate ... in a given year (cervical or lumbar)
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Conflicts with the 4 sessions per region cap in the line above (4 per region vs 2 per level); both can be true only if the 4 are split across levels.

requirement_kinds.quote: Predominant axial pain that is not attributable to radiculopathy (with the exception of facet joint synovial cysts), myelopathy, or neurogenic claudication
Physical exam findings which are consistent with the facet joint as the presumed source of pain
Absence of non-facet pathology that could explain the source of the patient's pain, such as fracture, tumor, or infection
Absence of prior surgical fusion at the proposed level
Lack of improvement or resolution after completing at least 6 weeks of conservative management for the current condition or episode of pain
Conservative management should include ... physical therapy AND at least one complementary conservative treatment strategy.
Failure of conservative management requires ALL of the following: ... completed a full course ... Worsening of or no significant improvement ... More invasive forms of therapy are being considered
Procedures must be performed with image guidance, either fluoroscopy or CT.
Evidence of nerve root compression due to a facet synovial cyst/large effusion when seen on an advanced imaging study (MRI or CT) performed within the previous 12 months
All imaging must be performed and read by an independent radiologist. If discrepancies should arise in the interpretation of the imaging, the radiology report will supersede.
suspected inflammatory facetogenic pain due to systemic inflammatory arthropathies clearly documented in the patient's history and assessment (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis)
Denervation is contraindicated (e.g., young person in whom denervation may result in muscle atrophy ...)

Individuals at risk for complications with radiofrequency neurotomy (RFN) treatment (e.g., pacemaker-dependent patients ... older individuals on anticoagulation therapy, presence of surgical hardware)
Provocative maneuvers or positions which normally exacerbate index pain should also be assessed and documented before and after the procedure.
Documentation of planned surgery or surgical consultation is required.

extraction_hazards: This copy is a redline ('Blue underline = Insertion; Red strikethrough = Deletion'). pdftotext keeps both inserted and deleted text with no marking, e.g. '© 20243' (2024 and struck 3), 'rootneural elements', 'glucocorticoidscorticosteroids', 'Effective Date: 04/14/2024 04/09/2023'. Any number in the facet section may be a deleted old value; the plain text cannot tell which.
Numbered exception list 1-4 interrupted by the page break and by an unnumbered 'For the exceptions listed above only:' list sitting between items 3 and 4.
Footnote markers 1 and 2 on 'Conservative management1' and 'analgesics2' with footnote text after the bullet list.
Repeated running header 'Interventional Pain Management' and footer copyright on every page.
Procedure-specific rules also appear in the General Clinical Guideline (pp.4-5) and in the epidural section, which uses the same defined terms with different thresholds.
Bullets render as private-use glyphs; sub-bullets (o) show as 'o' with variable indentation.
interesting_structures: General requirements with override: 'The specific requirements take precedence over any stated general requirement.'
Stepwise diagnostic-to-therapeutic design: dual MBB (80% relief each, 1 week apart) then RFN is preferred; therapeutic IA is the exception, available only under 4 enumerated conditions.
Diagnostic intra-articular facet injection is outright excluded; the only diagnostic route is MBB with local anesthetic only.
Per-level, per-region, per-session and per-year caps all appear (2 levels per session, 4 sessions per region, 2 diagnostic sessions per level).
Thoracic region excluded except C7-T1 and T12-L1 (the rest of the document's region definition mentions only cervical and lumbar).
Redline artifacts mean the document itself is a diff, which is hazardous for any parser.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Logic is expressible (all/any/not) but inheritance with override, exception pathways with sub-criteria, per-level/region/year counters, a document-wide framework that sits outside the section, and redline text that mixes deleted and inserted values all strain a tree. Several leaves need injection history that a single-visit chart rarely carries.
